esim.doc: Public /esim-deals consumer API: destinations, compare feed, event beacons, destination price-drop push alerts, analytics.

mobile.doc: Public /mobile-deals consumer API: normalized domestic feed, event beacons, carrier push alerts, email/WhatsApp reminders + the daily reminders job.

hotels.doc: Hotel Guest Connect: /api/guest/<slug> portal + QR, hotel CRUD, analytics and lead capture.

scrape.doc: Manual scrape triggers (/api/scrape-*-now), scrape progress SSE stream + the change-feed endpoints they share.

jobs.doc: Scheduled jobs (social sentiment, executive summary, news, resellers, morning digest, scraper drift) and their refresh / preview endpoints.

banners.doc: Carrier / e-store / global-provider banner screenshots and the Time Machine archive endpoints.

engagement.doc: Per-user engagement: alerts, watchlist, saved views, activity beacons, annotations, coupons, provider deals CRM.

chat.doc: /api/chat - Claude-powered assistant over the live plan data (rate-limited per user).

account.doc: Session / account endpoints: VAPID key, auth cookie session, Web Push subscriptions, my-role, preferences, context, contact form.

workspaces.doc: Super-admin + workspace-admin management: users (direct-DB provisioning), workspaces, invites, digest trigger, branding, Slack test, audit log.

history.doc: Price history: change log, market movers, per-plan series + batch sparklines, daily aggregates (price_history_daily), maintenance trigger, AI analysis.

usage.doc: Super-admin analytics: Claude API usage + budget, official Anthropic cost, user-activity overview, notification settings.
